coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Madrone
record.summary: A two-tower condominium complex by Bosa Development, whose project page says Madrone's two connected 16-storey towers were completed a few years after Radiance (2008); the Assessor roll gives 2012 as year built for the condominium lots at 420 and 480 Mission Bay Boulevard North and 435 China Basin Street, where the Department of Building Inspection recorded a 16-story, 329-unit new-construction permit completed in 2014.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8720117 (11,410 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 332 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8720117 and 331 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 142845124, name=Madrone Mission Bay, 480 Mission Bay Blvd N)); 99% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 88% of the lot.

record.notes: Unit count and opening year are not established by any cited source: Bosa's project page gives 693 units for Radiance, Madrone and Arden combined and says only that Radiance was the first major condominium development in the United States following the 2008 market downturn and that 'a few years later' Madrone's two connected 16-storey towers were completed (no year given); the Assessor roll gives year built 2012 (a roll year, not a completion event) for the condominium lots at 420 and 480 Mission Bay Blvd N and 435 China Basin St; and SocketSite (July 29, 2010) gave an expected move-in of mid-2012 for Radiance West, the name it later said had become Madrone (an expected date, not an opening).
